problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 7 delivery trucks to transport 7 different shipments across a network of 7 distribution hubs.

Each shipment consists of a fixed route represented as pairs (Hub, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the hub where the shipment must be processed and the amount of time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the hubs must be visited.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (H5, 8) → (H7, 7) → (H3, 1) → (H2, 8) → (H4, 1) → (H1, 9) → (H6, 7)
* S2 follows the route: (H7, 8) → (H4, 3) → (H2, 4) → (H6, 8) → (H1, 5) → (H5, 6) → (H3, 8)
* S3 follows the route: (H5, 1) → (H2, 3) → (H7, 6) → (H1, 1) → (H4, 6) → (H6, 10) → (H3, 3)
* S4 follows the route: (H7, 3) → (H4, 7) → (H6, 1) → (H2, 6) → (H5, 9) → (H3, 4) → (H1, 6)
* S5 follows the route: (H2, 10) → (H5, 8) → (H6, 1) → (H4, 4) → (H1, 8) → (H7, 10) → (H3, 6)
* S6 follows the route: (H5, 4) → (H6, 8) → (H2, 10) → (H1, 4) → (H4, 2) → (H3, 9) → (H7, 7)
* S7 follows the route: (H6, 6) → (H7, 9) → (H3, 6) → (H5, 8) → (H2, 7) → (H1, 8) → (H4, 6)

Each shipment must be processed continuously once it starts at a hub and cannot be interrupted,
and each hub can only handle one shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all shipments at the hubs
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
